Name: Horse Sound Framework
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[size=4]This does one simple thing - change the sound the horse makes into anything you want. Just download and install into your mods folder. Put any [b]ogg[/b] [b]or wav[/b] file into the assets to replace the sound. It automatically comes with 3 example sounds. These can be toggles in the config menu in the drop down menu. Comes preloaded with... Slither, Tinkling Bells, and Bicycle.[/size]

[size=4][b]**This only works with ogg or wav files. If you drop any other sound files in there in a different format the mod won't recognize them. **[/b][/size]

Manifest.Name: Horse Sound Framework
Manifest.Description: Movement-controlled horse audio with automatic audio file discovery, content packs, and immediate stopping.
Manifest.Author: CozyPsychologist
